heading.en: Paying the old partners for their reputation

hook.en: The new partner will enjoy profits that come partly from a reputation the old partners built. So he pays them a premium. Who receives it?
hook.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರು ಕಟ್ಟಿದ ಖ್ಯಾತಿಯಿಂದ ಬರುವ ಲಾಭವನ್ನು ಹೊಸಬ ಅನುಭವಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಅವನು ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅದು ಯಾರಿಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತದೆ?

title.en: Record premium for goodwill brought in cash
Record goodwill not brought in cash

say.en: The new partner will enjoy profits that come partly from a reputation the old partners built. So he pays them a premium. Who receives it? Today we pass the entries for the premium method and hidden goodwill. In this lesson: Record premium for goodwill brought in cash.
Record goodwill not brought in cash.
Calculate hidden goodwill.

body.en: AS 26 allows goodwill to be recorded only when it is purchased, so goodwill is not raised in the books on admission. If the new partner brings his share of goodwill in cash: Bank A/c Dr, To *Premium* for Goodwill A/c; then Premium for Goodwill A/c Dr, To sacrificing partners' Capital A/cs in the sacrificing ratio. If he does not bring it: New Partner's Current A/c Dr, To sacrificing partners' Capital A/cs. Existing goodwill in the books is first written off among old partners in the old ratio.
body.kn: AS 26 ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಖರೀದಿಸಿದ ಸುನಾಮ ಮಾತ್ರ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದಾಖಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರ ತಂದ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಅನ್ನು ತ್ಯಾಗ ಮಾಡಿದ ಪಾಲುದಾರರ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆಗಳಿಗೆ ತ್ಯಾಗದ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಮಾ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತರದಿದ್ದರೆ ಅವನ ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಹಾಕಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Premium for goodwill

narration.en: C brings one lakh capital and forty thousand premium for goodwill in cash.

say.en: C brings one lakh capital and forty thousand premium for goodwill in cash.
The premium goes to the partners who sacrificed, in the sacrificing ratio, here three to two.
Goodwill is not raised in the books: AS 26 allows only purchased goodwill.
Hidden goodwill: C brings one lakh for a quarter share, so the whole firm is worth four lakh.
C brings one lakh capital and forty thousand premium for goodwill in cash.

body.en: When goodwill is not stated, it can be inferred from the capital the new partner brings. Implied total capital = new partner's capital × reciprocal of his share. *Hidden goodwill* = implied total capital − (old partners' adjusted capitals + new partner's capital).
body.kn: ಸುನಾಮ ಹೇಳದಿದ್ದರೆ ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಬಂಡವಾಳದಿಂದ ಅದನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಬಹುದು. ಗುಪ್ತ ಸುನಾಮ = ಸೂಚಿತ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ − ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಾಲುದಾರರ ನಿಜವಾದ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ.

problem.en: A and B share profits 3:2. C is admitted for a 1/4 share and brings ₹1,00,000 as capital and ₹40,000 as premium for goodwill in cash. C takes his share from A and B in their old ratio. Pass the journal entries.

steps.en: Bank A/c Dr 1,40,000; To C's Capital A/c 1,00,000; To Premium for Goodwill A/c 40,000.
Premium for Goodwill A/c Dr 40,000; To A's Capital A/c 24,000; To B's Capital A/c 16,000.

answer.en: Premium of ₹40,000 is credited A ₹24,000 and B ₹16,000

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A and B share profits 3:2. C is admitted for a 1/4 share and brings ₹1,00,000 as capital and ₹40,000 as premium for goodwill in cash. C takes his share from A and B in their old ratio. Pass the journal entries.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A and B share profits 3:2. C is admitted for a 1 over 4 share and brings 1,00,000 rupees as capital and 40,000 rupees as premium for goodwill in cash. C takes his share from A and B in their old ratio. Pass the journal entries.
Sacrificing ratio equals old ratio equals 3:2.
Bank A over c Dr 1,40,000; To C's Capital A over c 1,00,000; To Premium for Goodwill A over c 40,000.
Premium for Goodwill A over c Dr 40,000; To A's Capital A over c 24,000; To B's Capital A over c 16,000.
So the answer is Premium of 40,000 rupees is credited A 24,000 rupees and B 16,000 rupees.

say.en: Now some questions in the pattern of the CUET UG Accountancy paper. A and B have adjusted capitals of 1,20,000 rupees and 80,000 rupees. C is admitted for a 1 over 4 share and brings 1,00,000 rupees as capital, but no premium for goodwill. The firm's hidden goodwill is.
Implied total capital equals 1,00,000 times 4 equals 4,00,000 rupees.
Actual capital equals 1,20,000 plus 80,000 plus 1,00,000 equals 3,00,000 rupees.
Hidden goodwill equals 1,00,000 rupees.
